title: Crispy Cauliflower Kebabs
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetarian dish inspired by Middle Eastern cuisine, featuring crispy cauliflower kebabs with a hint of spice.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cauliflower to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the cauliflower onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the kebabs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cauliflower is tender and lightly browned.
